title:
Epic that handles uploading {@link Feature} data for a current model scenario time window.

It expects the user to upload a CSV file containing timestamp and feature values, in the format:
```
| timestamp           | feature1 | feature2 | feature3 |
|---------------------|----------|----------|----------|
| 2023-01-01T00:00:00 | 1.0      | 2.0      | 3.0      |
| 2023-01-01T00:01:00 | 1.1      | 2.1      | 3.1      |
| 2023-01-01T00:02:00 | 1.2      | 2.2      | 3.2      |
```

Then that file is sent to {@link ModelScenarioChartHandler#convertCsvToValueGenerators} to build a {@link Map}
of {@link Feature} IDs to {@link ReliabilityMlModelScenario.ValueGenerator} objects, such that we can update
{@link ModelScenarioApplicationState#overriddenFeatures} with the new configuration.

**NOTE**: If no time range is selected, it will show an error banner indicating that no time range has been selected.
name: ModelScenarioUploadFeatureDataEpic
